name: mcp-laya
description: Fast, local, non-autoregressive System-1 decision engine as MCP tools — typed decisions (classify / score / yes-no) over text, email, tickets or JSON in 100+ languages, with calibrated confidence and no text generation, so nothing to hallucinate. Offloads routing/triage/gating judgment calls from the main model; runs on-device, offline by default. `pipx install mcp-laya`
